subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt and retarget the open dirty fork PR, or sponsor a narrow same-repository fix for the current direct Anthropic transport path?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but an open fork PR already uses closing syntax while the same-repository attempt is closed unmerged, so automation should not start a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Sponsor a same-repository fix
options.body: Close or ignore the dirty fork candidate and land a focused patch in the current Anthropic transport/header path with regression coverage.

options.title: Adopt and retarget the fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer to bring the fork change into the main repository, retarget it to current source layout, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the fork candidate
options.body: Leave this issue open with no new repair lane until the fork author updates the closing PR into a viable landing path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the dirty fork candidate and land a focused patch in the current Anthropic transport/header path with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent merged history on the Anthropic context-handling surface that overlaps the required fix.
